$comment: Story 2.5 — Recent Alerts card 649 × 444 (Full) / 240 (Small, All-good) at page 693, 246 (FR-73). Boxes are CARD coordinates (px, ±1 px, relative to the card slot) transcribed from PRD FR-73 to FR-77 and design spec Part B §6, §10, §12 to §14, with the offsets read off the 1× Figma renders (figma-reference/1x). Figma strokes take no layout, so the list 'Alarms' is the frame's 609 px content box at x 20, y 84 (card top 20 + header 56 + gap 8), column, gap 12. Alert item: icon column 20 (circle 20 × 20 at item y + 4), gap 16, detail column at item x + 36 (card x 56), 573 wide. Detail column 78 high: top row 42 (title 24 + meta 18; right block pt 4, severity 18 + time 18, right-aligned at card x 629), gap 4, Action link 24 high at item y + 46, then the 8 px padding whose bottom pixel row is the FR-76 separator (item y + 77: card y 161, 251, 341 in the Full frame, so the pitch is 90 = 78 + 12). The last row of a list of 2+ rows has no separator and no padding (Full row 4: 70 high, so the list is 3 × 90 + 70 = 340). Critical glyph 15 × 15 centred in its circle (+2.5); Warning glyph 13.846 at the 3.077 padding. Action arrow 16 × 16 at the label's right + 6, item y + 50. Empty state (All-good): 609 × 134 at 20, 84; title Roboto 700 16 / normal centred; body 377 wide, 2 lines of 20.3 px, centred. Copy is transcribed from the PRD (FR-73 to FR-77), not from the state JSON, so the two cross-check.
